description: Provides default configurations for 100+ language servers. Required for easy LSP setup — tells Neovim how to start each server, which filetypes it handles, and how to detect project roots. In Neovim 0.11+, nvim-lspconfig simply places config files in your runtimepath under lsp/<server>.lua. These are automatically loaded when you call vim.lsp.enable(). No require('lspconfig').setup() call is needed — just install the plugin and enable your servers.
author: neovim

exCommands.whatItDoes: Opens a floating window showing which language servers are running, their status, and which buffers they are attached to.
